name: hough_transform_detection
decomposition_rationale: Decompose into accumulator generation and local peak finding in Hough parameter space. This allows testing voting math separate from peak extraction heuristics.

atomic_nodes.name: compute_hough_accumulator
atomic_nodes.semantic_role: Populates the 2D Hough parameter accumulator from a binary edge image.
atomic_nodes.witness_shape_semantics: Creates a parameter space matrix size proportional to the desired angular resolution and diagonal image width.
atomic_nodes.complexity_reasoning: For every edge pixel, computes values for each angular bin.
